$comment: The Stop hook is what turns 'the model thinks it is done' into 'a check passed'.
scripts/verify.sh exits 2 when any gate fails, and exit code 2 is the only one Claude Code
treats as blocking — exit 1 is logged and ignored. So a red gate physically prevents the
session from finishing, and Claude keeps working with the failure text attached.
